Title: Blazor and C# APIs now supported in Azure Static Web Apps

Body.Content:
Static Web Apps offers a seamless experience for deploying static sites and serverless APIs. With the new support for Blazor WebAssembly and C# APIs powered by Azure Functions, Developers can build and publish applications built entirely in .NET with Static Web Apps.

Additionally, Static Web Apps now also supports building APIs in Python.

With these updates, JavaScript, C#, and Python developers can use Azure Static Web Apps to automatically build and deploy full stack applications from a GitHub repository. Static Web Sites also provides integrated features such as custom domains, free SSL certificates, global content distribution, and authentication.

To get started with Blazor in Static Web Apps, try the Quickstart guide.
